whatIDo.title: Data Analyst
whatIDo.description: Empowering strategic decision-making by transforming complex, fragmented datasets into clear, actionable intelligence. Specializing in end-to-end data workflows, advanced collection, preprocessing, and exploratory analysis using Python, SQL, Excel, and Power Query. Combining statistical methodologies with high-impact visual storytelling through dynamic dashboards in Power BI, Looker Studio and Tableau to bridge raw metrics with business growth.

whatIDo.title: ML Engineer
whatIDo.description: Architecting and deploying scalable, applied machine learning solutions tailored for real-world search and analytics ecosystems. Building robust computational pipelines focused on advanced techniques including embeddings, clustering, intent classification, and opportunity scoring. Designing insight-to-action architectures that seamlessly connect predictive algorithms with strategic execution.

whatIDo.title: Continuous Learner
whatIDo.description: Relentlessly expanding and pushing boundaries by transitioning from deep historical data analysis to advanced machine learning engineering. Constantly discovering and mastering state-of-the-art Python paradigms, automated pipelines, and predictive frameworks – bridging complex theories with high-performance, real-world execution.

experience.description: Leveraging advanced tools including Excel, Power Query, and Python to execute comprehensive data collection, cleaning, and preprocessing workflows, utilizing SQL for robust data extraction and transformation. Developed dynamic visualizations, dashboards, and analytical reports using Power BI, Looker Studio and Tableau. Applied statistical techniques and exploratory data analysis to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making, while integrating data governance, prompt engineering, and end-to-end execution through practical projects.

Built a strong foundation in data analytics focusing on data collection, management, and preprocessing, utilizing various data sources, storage solutions, and essential SQL and Excel skills for data extraction and transformation alongside data cleaning techniques and Python and R for data manipulation. Advanced to data analysis, visualization, and statistical techniques for decision-making, applying these concepts through hands-on practical projects using Excel, Python, R, and industry-standard platforms like Tableau and Power BI.

Applied machine learning and advanced analytics to real-world data, focusing on embeddings, clustering, intent classification, and opportunity scoring. Designed and executed insight-to-action reporting workflows that bridge raw data metrics with strategic, decision-making objectives, moving beyond standard dashboard visualization to deliver high-impact predictive solutions.
